scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:ai && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:ai: cd ai-service && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:ai: cd ai-service && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build -d
